units.source_text: 阿光侧着上半身，想从马背上跳下来。

en.t: Aguang leaned her upper body to one side, as if she meant to jump down from the horse.

units.source_text: 也许转念又想，自己穿着粉红色针织连裤袜，腿又短又粗，一离开马，多丑陋啊。

en.t: Perhaps she then thought better of it, realizing how ugly she would look once she left the horse, wearing pink knitted tights, with legs so short and thick.

units.source_text: 于是，她依然骑在马背上，掉转马头走近阿留。

en.t: So she stayed on the horse, turned its head around, and rode closer to Alou.
